title: Register your first service worker
why_it_matters: It is the engine behind offline PWAs.
explanation: A service worker is a script that sits between your page and the network. Registering it is just a feature check and one call. The file must be served from the scope it controls, so put sw.js at the site root. Requires https or localhost.
try_it: Look in DevTools, Application, Service Workers after registering.
